description: ECHO: Retrieve a full compliance profile for a single EPA-regulated facility by EPA Registry ID or EPA program ID. Returns facility metadata, the NAICS industry codes its programs record, ECHO's facility-level compliance status, a per-statute (CAA, CWA, RCRA, SDWA, and others ECHO tracks) compliance summary, inspections and other compliance monitoring records from the last five years (newest first, paged), five years of formal enforcement actions with penalties, five years of drinking-water violations with contaminant, measure, MCL, status, and enforcement actions (paged), Clean Water Act effluent limit exceedances by pollutant and outfall and RCRA violations (both paged), Clean Air Act High Priority Violations, every program ID linked to the facility, the latest TRI release total, and the facility's TRI facility IDs for epa_tri_get_facility_releases. Use epa_echo_search_facilities to discover Registry IDs; pass a public water system's PWSID from epa_water_search_systems to get its drinking-water violations. For area-level enforcement discovery use epa_echo_search_violations instead.

drinking_water_violations_limit.description: Number of drinking-water violations to return in one call. Default 25; a larger value returns at most 3,000 and says so. Page past it with drinking_water_violations_offset and drinkingWaterViolationsNextOffset.

drinking_water_violations_offset.description: Number of drinking-water violations to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's drinkingWaterViolationsNextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

effluent_exceedances_limit.description: Number of effluent exceedance series to return in one call. Default 10; a larger value returns the rest of the list. Page past it with effluent_exceedances_offset and effluentExceedancesNextOffset.

effluent_exceedances_offset.description: Number of effluent exceedance series to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's effluentExceedancesNextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

inspections_limit.description: Number of inspections to return in one call. Default 25; a larger value returns at most 5,000 and says so. Page past it with inspections_offset and inspectionsNextOffset.

inspections_offset.description: Number of inspections to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's inspectionsNextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

rcra_violations_limit.description: Number of RCRA violations to return in one call. Default 25; a larger value returns the rest of the list. Page past it with rcra_violations_offset and rcraViolationsNextOffset.

rcra_violations_offset.description: Number of RCRA violations to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's rcraViolationsNextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

registry_id.description: EPA FRS Registry ID for the facility (from epa_echo_search_facilities), or an EPA program ID ECHO resolves to one: a public water system PWSID (from epa_water_search_systems, e.g. WA5300484), a TRI facility ID, an NPDES permit, or a RCRA handler ID. The profile carries the resolved registryId.

name: epa_echo_get_facility

airCompliance.description: Present only when programs.air is true and ECHO reports a CAA status

programId.description: ICIS-Air ID if exactly one; absent when several (see programIds)

statusDate.description: End of the latest quarter covered, MM/DD/YYYY

compliance.description: From ECHO's facility search; absent when it reports none or fails

quartersInViolation.description: Of the last 12, with noncompliance under any program

complianceStatus.description: Facility-level status; absent when ECHO assigns none (as for TRI-only facilities) or its facility search failed (see notice)

drinkingWaterViolations.description: ECHO's 5-year SDWIS report for a public water system, newest compliance period first

items.description: One violation; empty fields absent, never defaulted

compliancePeriodEndDate.description: MM/DD/YYYY; absent for an open period

enforcementActions.description: Linked enforcement actions; absent when none

status.description: Resolved; Archived (no longer counts toward current compliance, can still carry resolvedDate); Addressed (unresolved, formal enforcement); Unaddressed (unresolved, none)

violationMeasure.description: Measured level, units included; absent when unrecorded, as for monitoring violations

drinkingWaterViolationsNextOffset.description: Next drinking_water_violations_offset; absent on the last page

effluentExceedances.description: CWA effluent limit exceedances, 13-quarter window, one per permit, outfall, parameter, location, and measurement type, in that order

measurementType.description: Mthly: monthly-average limit; NMth: non-monthly, usually a maximum; Neither: another kind

quarters.description: Quarters with an exceedance, oldest first

end.description: MM/DD/YYYY; the 13th ends at ECHO's last refresh

status.description: ECHO's code, S or R; absent when unsent

value.description: Highest percent over the limit as ECHO writes it, or LIMIT VIOLATION where that percent is not representative

effluentExceedancesNextOffset.description: Next effluent_exceedances_offset; absent on the last page

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `facility_not_found`: ECHO has no facility for registry_id. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

caseId.description: Pass to epa_echo_get_case for the civil case report; absent when none, as for RCRA and SDWA actions

inspections.description: Inspections and other compliance monitoring, 5-year window, newest first

category.description: Kind of record; absent for RCRA and SDWA records

inspectionsNextOffset.description: Next inspections_offset; absent on the last page

limitNotice.description: Present when a smaller limit than requested applied; says why.

naics.description: From the program records, each code once, ascending; programs can differ

notice.description: Present when ECHO's facility search failed, leaving out complianceStatus and compliance.

programCompliance.description: Per-statute summary; empty outside compliance-tracked programs, as for TRI-only facilities

programIds.description: FRS-linked program IDs besides the Registry ID, ECHO's order

items.description: One program ID; empty fields absent

status.description: Permit, operating, activity, or reporting status

system.description: EPA data system, as ECHO names it

programs.description: From the systems in the facility's detailed report

air.description: Has an ICIS-Air (CAA) record; emissions-inventory, risk-management, or greenhouse-gas entries alone do not count

tri.description: True exactly when triFacilityIds is non-empty

rcraViolationsNextOffset.description: Next rcra_violations_offset; absent on the last page

triFacilityIds.description: 15-character IDs, most recently reported first; pass one as facility_id to epa_tri_get_facility_releases. Several mean successive operators.

triReleasesTransfersInLbs.description: TRI releases and transfers in pounds for triReleasesTransfersYear; absent without TRI history

triReleasesTransfersYear.description: ECHO's latest TRI year for the facility

truncated.description: True when inspections, drinkingWaterViolations, effluentExceedances, or rcraViolations has more pages; absent otherwise.

waterCompliance.description: Present only when programs.water is true and ECHO reports a CWA status

permitId.description: NPDES permit ID if exactly one; absent when several (see programIds)

title: Get EPA Facility Compliance Profile
